title: Element 115 used to amplify gravity

tellings.quote: uh they according to Bob Lazar, they didn't I don't remember him telling me this, but according to Bob Lazar, they also use element 115 sometimes to amplify the the gravitational effect.

plain: Element 115, a superheavy chemical element, is sometimes used to boost the gravity effect that drives an alien craft, according to Bob Lazar, a man who has spoken publicly about how such craft are said to work. Steve Colbern, a scientist who studies objects said to be alien implants in human bodies, passes this on to Michels while admitting he doesn't remember Lazar telling him so himself. If true, it would mean the craft move by working on gravity directly.
